method: Render DOCX with bundled render_docx.py (LibreOffice); render PDFs with pdftoppm; inspect every 1-page PNG using view_image at original resolution.

artifacts.observed: One page; all paragraphs and the 4-stage table legible; no clipping. Removed default title border in generator then rerendered and reviewed.
One page; title, table and exceptions/coverage paragraphs legible; no clipping.
One image-only page; business text/table legible except deliberately obscured approval-role cell. Obscured cell is a synthetic shape, not a recoverable real value.

limitations: Visual QA is fixture-author self-check, not independent model-output parity review.
The scan fixture tests uncertainty handling, not an OCR accuracy benchmark.
